answer: The leaf-painter table holds the silk leaves stretched on frames, pale and waiting for colour. Proof of leaf-painter via silk leaf tally — a leaf the leaf-painter paints only after 31 leaves dry bright without one colour running, each leaf painted by the leaf-painter herself. haven mixes the pigment with gum and tests it on a scrap. prism paints the blossom petal by petal and leaves it to dry. canyon outlines the stems in gold and checks the leaf against the light. Thirty-one leaves must dry bright without one colour running, and the next still blotches where the silk ran damp.
